description: QUIET (Q/U Imaging ExperimenT), a CMB polarization experiment with Q-band and W-band receivers. The curves are the Q-band and W-band bandpass profiles of the 1st+2nd season galactic-fields data release (response to a source of uniform spectral radiance, peak 1), converted from frequency to wavelength.
facility_description: QUIET (Q/U Imaging ExperimenT) CMB polarization experiment; instrument described in QUIET Collaboration (2013), ApJ 768, 9.

notes: Q-band: averaged over detector diodes RQ00-RQ15 (file header). W-band: 'the response for one representative detector diode, and, unlike the QUIET Q-band profile, is thus not averaged over detector diodes' (file header); LAMBDA: 'It therefore has an additional uncertainty'. Negative noise set to 0. Pivots agree with SVO's QUIET/QUIET.Q/W records within 0.05%. DetectorType energy is assumed.
